Hanno Festival Charity Golf Tournament—Participants Wanted

Date and time: Friday, June 19, 2026
Venue: Hanno Green Country Club (292 Kusumi, Hanno)
Who can enter: Club members and their employees
Capacity: 40 groups, 160 people

The tournament uses an 18-hole new peoria format. Entry fee is 3,000 yen (paid on the day), and play fees are 16,900 yen including tax and meal. The awards ceremony will be held around 3 p.m. at the clubhouse after play ends.

Application deadline: Friday, May 8, 2026
Inquiries and applications: Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Charity Golf Tournament Executive Committee Office
TEL 042-974-3111 / FAX 042-972-7871

We are also asking businesses to sponsor the Hanno Festival or donate prizes for the golf tournament. If you wish to sponsor, please apply by FAX by May 8.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2389/
